ayahs.2: Jis ke waaqe hone mein koi jhoot nahin.
ayahs.3: Woh past karne wali aur buland karne wali hogi.
ayahs.4: Jabke zameen zalzala ke saath hila di jaayegi.
ayahs.5: Aur pahaad bilkul reza-reza kar diye jaayenge.
ayahs.6: Phir woh misl-e-paraaganda ghubaar ke ho jaayenge.
ayahs.7: Aur tum teen jamaaton mein ho jaaoge.
ayahs.8: Pas daahne haath wale kaise achhe hain daahne haath wale.
ayahs.9: Aur baayen haath wale kya haal hai baayen haath walon ka.
ayahs.10: Aur jo aage wale hain woh to aage wale hi hain.
ayahs.11: Woh bilkul nazdeeki haasil kiye hue hain.
ayahs.13: (Bahut bada) giroh to agle logon mein se hoga.
ayahs.14: Aur thode se pichhle logon mein se.
ayahs.15: Yeh log sone ke taaron se bane hue takhton par.
ayahs.16: Ek doosre ke saamne takiya lagaaye baithe honge.
ayahs.17: Un ke paas aise ladke jo hamesha (ladke hi) rahenge aamad-o-raft karenge.
ayahs.18: aab-khoray aur jug le kar aur aisa jaam le kar jo behti hui sharaab se pur ho.
ayahs.19: Jis se na sar mein dard ho na aql mein fatoor aaye.
ayahs.20: Aur aise meway liye hue jo un ki pasand ke hon.
ayahs.21: Aur parindon ke gosht jo unhein marghoob hon.
ayahs.22: Aur badi badi aankhon wali hooren.
ayahs.23: Jo chhupe hue motiyon ki tarah hain.
ayahs.24: Yeh sila hai un ke aamaal ka.
ayahs.25: Na wahan bakwaas sunenge aur na gunaah ki baat.
ayahs.26: Sirf salaam hi salaam ki aawaz hogi.
ayahs.27: Aur daahne haath wale kya hi achhe hain daahne haath wale.
ayahs.33: Jo na khatam hon na rok liye jaayen.
ayahs.34: Aur oonche oonche farshon mein honge.
ayahs.35: Hum ne un ki (biwiyon ko) khaas taur par banaaya hai.
ayahs.36: Aur hum ne unhein kunwariyan bana diya hai.
ayahs.38: Daayen haath walon ke liye hain.
ayahs.40: Aur bahut badi jamaat hai pichhlon mein se.
ayahs.41: Aur baayen haath wale kya hain baayen haath wale.
ayahs.42: Garam hawa aur garam paani mein (honge).
ayahs.43: Aur siyaah dhuen ke saaye mein.
ayahs.44: Jo na thanda hai na farhat-bakhsh.
ayahs.45: Beshak yeh log is se pehle bahut naazon mein pale hue the.
ayahs.46: Aur bade bade gunaahon par israar karte the.
ayahs.47: Aur kehte the ke kya jab hum mar jaayenge aur mitti aur haddi ho jaayenge to kya hum phir dobaara utha khade kiye jaayenge.
ayahs.48: Aur kya hamare agle baap-daada bhi?
ayahs.49: Aap keh dijiye ke yaqeenan sab agle aur pichhle.
ayahs.50: Zaroor jama kiye jaayenge ek muqarrar din ke waqt.
ayahs.51: Phir tum ae gumraaho jhutlaane walo!
ayahs.52: Albatta khaane wale ho thohr ka darakht.
ayahs.53: Aur isi se pait bharne wale ho.
ayahs.54: Phir is par garam khaulta paani peene wale ho.
ayahs.55: Phir peene wale bhi pyaase oonton ki tarah.
ayahs.56: Qayamat ke din un ki mehmani yeh hai.
ayahs.57: Hum hi ne tum sab ko paida kiya hai phir tum kyun baawar nahin karte?
ayahs.58: Achha phir yeh to batlaao ke jo mani tum tapkaate ho.
ayahs.59: Kya is ka (insaan) tum banaate ho ya paida karne wale hum hi hain?
ayahs.60: Hum hi ne tum mein maut ko mutayyan kar diya hai aur hum is se haare hue nahin hain.
ayahs.61: Ke tumhari jagah tum jaise aur paida kar den aur tumhein naye sire se is aalam mein paida karen jis se tum (bilkul) bekhabar ho.
ayahs.62: Tumhein yaqini taur par pehli dafa ki paidaish maloom hi hai phir kyun ibrat haasil nahin karte?
ayahs.63: Achha phir yeh bhi batlaao ke tum jo kuchh bote ho.
ayahs.64: Ise tum hi ugaate ho ya hum ugaane wale hain.
ayahs.65: Agar hum chaahein to ise reza-reza kar daalen aur tum hairat ke saath baatein banaate hi reh jaao.
ayahs.66: Ke hum par to taawaan hi pad gaya.
ayahs.67: Balke hum bilkul mehroom hi reh gaye.
ayahs.68: Achha yeh bataao ke jis paani ko tum peete ho.
ayahs.69: Ise baadalon se bhi tum hi utaarte ho ya hum barsaate hain?
ayahs.70: Agar hamari mansha ho to hum ise kadwa zehar kar den phir tum hamari shukr-guzaari kyun nahin karte?
ayahs.71: Achha zara yeh bhi bataao ke jo aag tum sulgaate ho.
ayahs.72: Is ke darakht ko tum ne paida kiya hai ya hum is ke paida karne wale hain?
ayahs.73: Hum ne ise sabab-e-naseehat aur musaafiron ke faide ki cheez banaaya hai.
ayahs.74: Pas apne bahut bade Rabb ke naam ki tasbeeh kiya karo.
ayahs.75: Pas main qasam khaata hoon sitaaron ke girne ki.
ayahs.76: Aur agar tumhein ilm ho to yeh bahut badi qasam hai.
ayahs.77: Ke beshak yeh Quran bahut badi izzat wala hai.
ayahs.78: Jo ek mahfooz kitaab mein darj hai.
ayahs.79: Jise sirf paak log hi chhoo sakte hain.
ayahs.80: Yeh Rabbul-Aalameen ki taraf se utra hua hai.
ayahs.81: Pas kya tum aisi baat ko sarsari (aur maamooli) samajh rahe ho?
ayahs.82: Aur apne hisse mein yehi lete ho ke jhutlaate phiro.
ayahs.83: Pas jabke rooh narkharay tak pahunch jaaye.
ayahs.84: Aur tum is waqt aankhon se dekhte raho.
ayahs.85: Hum is shakhs se ba-nisbat tumhare bahut zyada qareeb hote hain lekin tum nahin dekh sakte.
ayahs.86: Pas agar tum kisi ke zer-farmaan nahin.
ayahs.87: Aur is qaul mein sachche ho to (zara) is rooh ko to lautaao.
ayahs.88: Pas jo koi baargaah-e-Ilahi se qareeb kiya hua hoga.
ayahs.89: Ise to raahat hai aur ghizaayen hain aur aaraam wali jannat hai.
ayahs.90: Aur jo shakhs daahne (haath) walon mein se hai.
ayahs.91: To bhi salaamati hai tere liye ke tu daahne walon mein se hai.
ayahs.92: Lekin agar koi jhutlaane walon gumraahon mein se hai.
ayahs.93: To khaultay hue garam paani ki mehmani hai.
ayahs.95: Yeh khabar sarasar haq aur qat'an yaqini hai.
ayahs.96: Pas tu apne azeem-ush-shaan Parwardigaar ki tasbeeh kar.
